Class SsFormatterFactory

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.JFormattedTextField.AbstractFormatterFactory
javax.swing.text.DefaultFormatterFactory
dev.visdb.seesaw.formatting.FormatterFactory
dev.visdb.seesaw.formatting.SsFormatterFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class SsFormatterFactory extends FormatterFactory
General NullAware formatter factory for SS. During build, if no defaultFromatter, try to create one from displayFormatter; just in case.

MaskFormatter doesn't use this.
